source.author: verg
source.text: illa cadens raucum per levia murmur saxa ciet, scatebrisque arentia temperat arva.
source.text_original: illa cadens raucum per levia murmur / saxa ciet, scatebrisque arentia temperat arva.
source.text_english: As it falls, it stirs a hoarse murmur over the smooth stones and moistens the parched fields with its springs.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: uel fiscellam texe iunco uel canistrum lentis plecte uiminibus, sariatur humus, areolae aequo limite diuidantur; in quibus cum holerum iacta fuerint semina uel plantae per ordinem positae, aquae ducantur irriguae, ut pulcherrimorum uersuum spectator assistas: ecce supercilio cliuosi tramitis undam elicit, illa cadens raucum per leuia murmur saxa ciet scatebrisque arentia temperat arua.
reuse.text_original: uel fiscellam texe iunco uel canistrum lentis plecte uiminibus, sariatur humus, areolae aequo limite diuidantur; in quibus cum holerum iacta fuerint semina uel plantae per ordinem positae, aquae ducantur irriguae, ut pulcherrimorum uersuum spectator assistas: ecce supercilio cliuosi tramitis undam elicit, illa cadens raucum per leuia murmur saxa ciet scatebrisque arentia temperat arua.
reuse.text_english: Either weave a little basket with rushes or plait a small hamper with osiers; let the ground be hoed, let the little beds be divided by an even boundary; and when the seeds of vegetables have been scattered in them or the seedlings set out in order, let irrigating waters be led in, so that you may stand by as a spectator of most beautiful verses: see, from the brow of the sloping path she draws forth a stream, and, falling, it stirs up a hoarse murmur over the smooth stones and by its springs moistens the parched fields.
